svg.text: 13th attempt notebook and 14th attempt products: from evidence layers to prospectivity maps
Flow of prospectividad_carlin_GAT_v8_bagging_sin_lito_lineam.ipynb. Notebook cell in brackets; figures come from the team run (salida folder, October 18, 2026).
Geophysics, hydro, rocks, silica, stream, soils
from separate rasters to a node table
each cell is a node; edges join neighboring cells
each cell links to its 8 neighbors
Data(x = X, edge_index) on the GPU
defined here; trained in D and E
Layer 1: dropout 0.5 · GATConv 10 to 16 x 8 heads · ELU
Layer 2: dropout 0.5 · GATConv 128 to 16 x 8 heads · ELU
Layer 3: dropout 0.5 · GATConv 128 to 16 x 8 heads · ELU
Linear 128 to 1: one logit per cell
Each layer widens the view by one hop: with 3 layers a cell
sees neighbors up to 3 cells away (4.5 km at 1500 m).
LogReg, RF, HistGB, SVM, MLP, RF_ctx
one value per cell, no neighbors
minmax rescales the score to 0 to 1
each cell is scored by a model that never saw its block
in the end, oof holds one
ROC_AUC, PR_AUC, SRC_AUC, Youden, MCC, F1,
Brier, ECE, capture at P80, P90, P95
GAT, GAT_bag, LogReg, RF: shuffle one layer
success-rate curve and AUC per fold
model shown: GAT; spatially validated figures
oof from D and maps from E
order unchanged: same AUC per fold
probability of at least one known
1. Bands A and B run once. Band D trains 5 x 8 = 40 models to measure performance; band E trains 3 per model on all mines to draw the maps.
2. Maps (E) and metrics (D) come from different models: the metrics are honest because they never score a block seen in training.
3. Negative does not mean barren: it is a cell with no known mine and more than 2500 m from one. Favorability therefore ranks cells; it is not a true probability.
4. GAT_bag costs 4 times as much as the GAT (about 165 s per fold versus 41 s on the team GTX 1650).
5. Band F retrains nothing: it takes the out-of-fold predictions from D to measure and the maps from E to draw.
